list: The 55 trophies as the kit carries them, checked against Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18
note: Grand Theft Auto VI launches 19 November 2026. Rockstar, Sony and Microsoft had published no official trophy list before launch. Steps beyond the official descriptions are marked reported or unverified, and each guide names its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks when the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do. Work the roadmap in order; the last trophy to fall is usually A Long Road (100% completion) or a final count trophy. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours and difficulty 4 out of 10, so this is a long but gentle platinum.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
The platinum pops automatically once the last one is in.
Follow the seven roadmap stages in order so nothing is left for the end.

Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.

steps: Play the story to its final mission.
Finish the final mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The 100% checklist appears in the game after the story (Progress, then 100% Completion, per Push Square), but progress made earlier counts. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy and says the checklist is about 60% of true completion — most of it comes from the other trophies, so work the roadmap in order and this is the last gold to fall.
steps: Finish the story first.
Open Progress, then 100% Completion, to see the checklist.
Clear the checklist items; most are shared with other trophies.

steps: Attempt stunts while driving around Leonida.
You need 250 of the 397 stunts Push Square reports.
Log your count here as you go.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. PowerPyx reports the tracker counts 9 activity types, viewable at Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. Try one of each — fishing, races, the shooting range, bowling, arcade games, drone races and the rest — and the trophy pops. Trying is the requirement; you do not need to win.
steps: Open Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities to see the 9 types.
Try each type once.
Any single attempt counts; you do not need to win.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. KeenGamer reports 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. This is the only trophy the guides flag as possibly missable: PowerPyx reports the first meditation, at Jason's house, is offered in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, and there is no mission replay. Do it the moment it is offered in Chapter 1, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house the moment the spot is offered.
Meditate at every spot you find as you play — 18 in total, KeenGamer reports.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter in case you miss one.
There is no mission replay, PowerPyx reports, so a missed Chapter 1 spot cannot be replayed.
